title: Detailed cupcake
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='frosting' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffe0f0'/>
      <stop offset='50%' stop-color='#ffb6d9'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ff8ec7'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='cup' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffd54f'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ff8f00'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='cupShade' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffe082'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffb300'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Cake base / wrapper -->
  <path d='M28 56 L32 88 Q32 92 36 92 L64 92 Q68 92 68 88 L72 56 Z' fill='url(#cup)'/>

  <!-- Wrapper ridges -->
  <path d='M34 56 L36 90' stroke='#ffca28' stroke-width='2' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M42 56 L43 91' stroke='#ffca28' stroke-width='2' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M50 56 L50 92' stroke='#ffca28' stroke-width='2' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M58 56 L57 91' stroke='#ffca28' stroke-width='2' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M66 56 L64 90' stroke='#ffca28' stroke-width='2' fill='none'/>

  <!-- Wrapper top rim -->
  <rect x='26' y='52' width='48' height='6' rx='3' fill='#ffca28'/>
  <rect x='26' y='52' width='48' height='3' rx='3' fill='#ffe082'/>

  <!-- Frosting base swirl -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='53' rx='26' ry='8' fill='url(#frosting)'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='24' ry='6' fill='#ffd0e5'/>

  <!-- Frosting middle swirl -->
  <path d='M28 50 Q30 30 42 28 Q50 26 56 30 Q66 34 70 46 Q72 52 66 54 Q58 56 50 54 Q38 52 28 50 Z' fill='url(#frosting)'/>

  <!-- Frosting highlight -->
  <path d='M34 44 Q36 34 44 32 Q50 31 54 34 Q58 37 58 42' stroke='#fff0f8' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- Frosting top swirl -->
  <path d='M38 38 Q40 22 50 18 Q58 16 62 24 Q66 30 62 38 Q56 44 48 40 Q42 38 38 38 Z' fill='#ffc2e0'/>

  <!-- Frosting dollop -->
  <path d='M44 28 Q46 14 54 12 Q60 11 62 18 Q62 24 56 28 Q50 30 44 28 Z' fill='#ffd6ec'/>

  <!-- Frosting curl tip -->
  <path d='M52 16 Q56 8 60 12 Q62 16 58 20' fill='#ffe6f2'/>

  <!-- Sprinkle sprinkles -->
  <rect x='38' y='36' width='4' height='2' rx='1' fill='#ff5252' transform='rotate(30 40 37)'/>
  <rect x='44' y='30' width='4' height='2' rx='1' fill='#69f0ae' transform='rotate(-20 46 31)'/>
  <rect x='50' y='38' width='4' height='2' rx='1' fill='#40c4ff' transform='rotate(15 52 39)'/>
  <rect x='56' y='32' width='4' height='2' rx='1' fill='#ffab40' transform='rotate(-35 58 33)'/>
  <rect x='34' y='44' width='4' height='2' rx='1' fill='#ea80fc' transform='rotate(45 36 45)'/>
  <rect x='60' y='42' width='4' height='2' rx='1' fill='#ffd740' transform='rotate(-10 62 43)'/>
  <rect x='46' y='44' width='4' height='2' rx='1' fill='#ff4081' transform='rotate(25 48 45)'/>
  <rect x='40' y='48' width='4' height='2' rx='1' fill='#18ffff' transform='rotate(-40 42 49)'/>
  <rect x='54' y='46' width='4' height='2' rx='1' fill='#b2ff59' transform='rotate(35 56 47)'/>
  <circle cx='36' cy='40' r='1.5' fill='#ff80ab'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='38' r='1.5' fill='#80d8ff'/>
  <circle cx='48' cy='26' r='1.5' fill='#ffeb3b'/>

  <!-- Cherry -->
  <circle cx='52' cy='14' r='6' fill='#e53935'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='14' r='6' fill='#ff5252' opacity='0.5'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='12' rx='2' ry='1.5' fill='#ff8a80'/>

  <!-- Cherry stem -->
  <path d='M52 8 Q54 3 58 2' stroke='#66bb6a' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- Shadow under cupcake -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='93' rx='22' ry='3' fill='#3a2a3a' opacity='0.4'/>
</svg>
